burst_summary.how_counted: The short went from 0.015 to 0.01668 BTC: 12 orders of 0.00014 BTC. 6 answered 'filled'; 6 more ran in OutLayer after the backend had stopped waiting (outlayer_unknown). The gateway's lock ran them one at a time.
burst_summary.why_some_timed_out: OutLayer runs only a few jobs at once per payment key, so most of the 40 queued; the backend gives up after 60 s. Messages expire 90 s after signing, so no late run could post afterwards.

burst_recheck.why: The script's own check after the burst timed out at OutLayer (HTTP 502), so the step recorded 'not passed' without an answer. This preview was run by hand through /api/preview.
